title.zh: 低于本厂可铸最小壁厚

reason.zh: 本厂铸造最小壁厚 0.6 mm，来料 {min_wall_thickness_mm} mm 无法充满型腔。
reason.en: This workshop casts down to 0.6 mm; the submitted {min_wall_thickness_mm} mm will not fill the mould.

text.zh: 把最小壁厚提到 0.8 mm 以上，或改为空心铸造并加内支撑。
text.en: Raise the minimum wall to 0.8 mm or switch to hollow casting with internal supports.

reason.zh: 本厂最大铸件尺寸 45 mm，来料 {max_dimension_mm} mm 需要分件或转厂。
reason.en: The casting envelope is 45 mm; {max_dimension_mm} mm needs splitting or another workshop.

text.zh: 拆成可焊接的两个部件，或转 WS-JW-B 评估。
text.en: Split into two solderable parts, or re-assess at WS-JW-B.

reason.zh: 本厂排产合金为 18k/22k 金、925 银、pt950，来料 {alloy} 不在其中。
reason.en: This workshop schedules 18k/22k gold, 925 silver and pt950; {alloy} is not supported.

text.zh: 改用本厂支持合金，或改派到具备该合金工艺的车间。
text.en: Switch to a supported alloy or route to a workshop that handles it.

title.zh: 戒圈小于本厂最小手寸

reason.zh: 本厂撑圈模具覆盖 44-62 mm 内周长，来料 {ring_size_mm} mm 无对应模具。
reason.en: Mandrels cover 44-62 mm inner circumference; {ring_size_mm} mm has no matching tool.

text.zh: 调整到 46 mm 以上，或改做开口戒。
text.en: Adjust to at least 46 mm, or design an open band.

title.zh: 戒圈大于本厂最大手寸

reason.zh: 本厂撑圈模具上限 62 mm，来料 {ring_size_mm} mm 超限。
reason.en: Mandrels stop at 62 mm; {ring_size_mm} mm exceeds the tooling.

text.zh: 缩到 60 mm 以内，或改为可调节结构。
text.en: Reduce below 60 mm, or use an adjustable structure.

reason.zh: 本厂珐琅窑上限 820 摄氏度，来料烧成温度 {enamel_firing_c} 摄氏度超限。
reason.en: The kiln tops out at 820 C; the submitted firing temperature is {enamel_firing_c} C.

text.zh: 改用低温珐琅（780 摄氏度以下），或改派到高温窑车间。
text.en: Use a low-fire enamel below 780 C, or route to a workshop with a hotter kiln.

qc_checkpoints.method: digital caliper, three points per axis
qc_checkpoints.pass_criteria: all dimensions within 0.05 mm, minimum wall not below the assessed value

qc_checkpoints.method: manual pull test plus loupe inspection at 10x
qc_checkpoints.pass_criteria: no stone movement, no prong gap above 0.02 mm

qc_checkpoints.method: visual inspection under daylight lamp, hallmark verification
qc_checkpoints.pass_criteria: no polishing compound residue, hallmark and purity mark legible
